summary: Petition under Sections 17(3) and 17(4) of the Electricity Act, 2003, for the creation of security interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, Respondent No. 1, as the Security Trustee, acting for the benefit of the Lender, Respondent No. 2. 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition under Section 17 of the Act seeking approval for the creation of security interest over its movable and immovable assets in favour of Respondent No. 1, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (hereinafter referred to as the "Security Trustee"), acting for and on behalf of and for the benefit of Respondent No. 2 i.e., Aseem Infrastructure Finance Limited (hereinafter referred to as the "Lender"), including their subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees and any refinancing lenders to the Project, pursuant to the Security Trustee Agreement, Facility Agreement, and other financing documents executed in connection with the Project. The Petitioner has made the following prayers: _(b) approve the creation of the security interest by the Petitioner by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ lien/ assignment etc. (as applicable) over all the assets, including the movable and immovable assets, Project accounts, Project documents (including the transmission license) etc. of the Petitioner in favour of Respondent No. 1/ Security Trustee (or its replacement_ _or successor) to secure the Petitioner’s obligations towards Respondent No. 2 (the Lender) under the Facility Agreement dated 25.02.2026;_ _(c) approve the creation of Security Interest by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ lien/ assignment etc. over all the assets, including the movable and immovable assets, Project accounts, Project documents (including the transmission license) etc. of the Petitioner in favour of Respondent No. 1/ Security Trustee (or its replacement or successor) to secure the Petitioner’s obligations towards Respondent No. 2 (the Lender) under the Facility Agreement dated 25.02.2026 and for their subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees and substitutes thereof in respect to the Project; and for amendment of the security documents and any other Financing Agreements to include the assigns, transferees and novatees of the Lender; and_ _(d) pass any such other relief as the Commission deems fit and appropriate in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_ 3. The Petitioner was initially incorporated as a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) and was a wholly owned subsidiary of PFC Consulting Limited (PFCCL) for the implementation of the Project. Subsequently, upon being selected as the successful bidder, M/s Sterlite Grid 24 Limited acquired the Petitioner from PFCCL on 6.12.2022, following which the Petitioner became the Transmission Service Provider (TSP). - (a) The Petitioner, in its capacity as an inter-State Transmission Licensee and 5. The Petitioner has submitted that, pursuant to the terms of Schedule 8 of the Facility Agreement, it is required to create a security interest in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, _inter alia,_ as follows: (i) all the rights, title, interests, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Borrower in the Project Documents including but not limited to TSA, subject to approval from CERC), both present and future, duly acknowledged and consented to by the counterparties to the Project Documents (if such Project Document requires prior consent (ii) the rights, title, claims, interests and benefits of the Borrower in, to and under all the Approvals, both present and future, in relation to the Project, as may be permitted under Applicable Law; 9. The Petition was listed for hearing on 3.6.2026 after notice to the Respondents. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) dated 3.6.2026, the Respondents were granted the opportunity to file their respective replies. 10. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner mainly reiterated the submissions made in the Petition and submitted that, despite notice, none of the Respondents has filed a reply. Accordingly requested that the matter be reserved for orders. In view of the submissions made by the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the matter was reserved for orders. - _i. the Lenders or the Lenders' Representative on their behalf shall have entered into the Financing Agreements and agreed in writing to the provisions of this Agreement; and_ _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ 18. The Petitioner and the Lender, have appointed Catalyst Trusteeship Limited as the Security Trustee for the creation of a Security Interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Project. In our view, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited needs to be given comfort that security will be created for the benefit of the Lender, as security for the financial assistance provided by them. We, therefore, accord approval allowing the Petitioner to create a Security Interest in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, acting as the Security Trustee for and on behalf of the lender, including their subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees and any refinancing lenders to the Project, by way of mortgage or any other security document over the Project assets through execution of the Indenture of Mortgage and other financing documents relating to the Project. The Petitioner is directed to submit a signed copy of the Indenture of Mortgage for the Project immediately after its execution.
